items.title: Show HN: Reviving a 2012 open-source password manager for modern Android
items.summary: Offline password manager for Android: a fork of Passdroid (last release 2012), brought up to date. The app has no internet permission.Two key new features: - 2FA codes (TOTP) - fingerprint unlockPlus many smaller changes and fixes, and security hardening: AES-256 with PBKDF2 at 600k iterations, AES-GCM encrypted exports. Threat model and design are in INTERNALS.md.Built largely with Claude Code; the design and security decisions are mine.Feedback welcome, especially on the security side. Comment...
